last.verdict: Moderna swung to a profit on international COVID vaccine sales and raised its revenue outlook, but much of the new cash comes from borrowing.

takeaways.label: Profit on COVID deliveries
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 29% to $1.3B, driven by international COVID vaccine deliveries, and net income was $162M versus a $200M loss a year ago. R&D spending fell 27%.

takeaways.label: Outlook raised
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue growth is now expected at 15%–25%, up from up to 10%. Full-year R&D spending is now about $2.7B, down from $2.9B.

takeaways.label: Cash boosted by debt
takeaways.text: Year-end cash is now seen at $8.1–8.3B, up from $4.7–5.2B. About $2.6B of that is net proceeds from new convertible notes. Most quarterly sales were still uncollected.

takeaways.label: Melanoma shot, flu launch
takeaways.text: The melanoma vaccine with Merck cut recurrence or death risk 42% in Phase 3. The new flu vaccine got FDA approval but launches only in limited form this season.

history.verdict: Norovirus vaccine setback outweighed a smaller-than-expected loss and lower costs.

reasons.label: Norovirus vaccine setback
reasons.text: Phase 3 norovirus vaccine missed early-success bar; more patients must be enrolled, delaying it.

reasons.label: Pipeline over numbers
reasons.text: Revenue is only $145M, so the stock trades on upcoming flu and melanoma news.

reasons.label: Cost cuts, cash runway
reasons.text: Spending outlook trimmed about $0.2B; year-end cash now seen at $4.7–5.2B.
